brand.name: Rafid
brand.tagline: One live view of every sale, across every platform

hero.subheadline: Rafid unifies your orders and cashflow from every delivery and e-commerce platform into a single live dashboard. See exactly what you earn and when it lands, and unlock the cash locked behind the aggregators whenever you need it.

quote.body: I finally see all my delivery and store orders in one place, and my locked earnings reach me the day I need them instead of two weeks later.

problem.title: Vision 2030 wants banks financing far more small businesses. Assessing them is the blocker.
problem.body: Saudi small and medium businesses drive the economy, yet only a fraction can access bank financing. The barrier is not appetite, it is visibility: a merchant's real sales are scattered across delivery and e-commerce aggregators, and their earnings sit locked for weeks. Banks like Alinma cannot easily see who is creditworthy, so they underwrite far fewer SMEs than the Vision 2030 target.

target.label: Vision 2030 target for the SME share of bank financing

actual.label: Roughly where big banks sit today, about halfway there

solution.title: A platform that works both ways
solution.body: Rafid is software powered by an AI engine that reads a merchant's sales across every aggregator, together with open banking data, to understand the business. Merchants get one unified view of their cashflow and the option to draw their locked earnings early. Alinma gets a clear, evidence-based read on which SMEs are ready to underwrite.

model.title: Priced on your operations, never on your money
model.body: Rafid subscriptions scale with operational volume, the number of sales we process, not with any financing amount. Charging on financing volume would be bay al-dayn, so we never do it. More sales means more work on our side, and that is the only thing our tiers are built on.
model.note: Sharia-compliant by design: subscription tiers track sales volume, not financing value.
